mission: Bring the Smart Board experience to the canonical NayaNET Hub standard while completing the proof chain SOURCE → BUILD → ARTIFACT → CLOUDFLARE → DEPLOYMENT → RUNTIME → USER EXPERIENCE.
human_intent: Deploy the supplied NayaNET Hub artifact to the supplied Cloudflare Worker and verify that the live runtime serves it.
authority: User-authorized Cloudflare target, canonical repository evidence, and deployment/runtime receipts.
constraints: Preserve the supplied Hub artifact exactly as the deployment source.
Do not use AppDeploy, Vercel, or GitHub 509 as production substitutes.
Do not expose or request Cloudflare secrets.
Preserve SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_SHA separately from recording commits.
Never mark VERIFIED without deployment and independent runtime evidence.

source_truth.rule: LIVE HEAD > RECORDED HEAD; recording commits are not build snapshots

browser_verification_attempt.observation: Direct browser retrieval returned cache-miss errors for both targets; no rendered-page inspection was obtained.
browser_verification_attempt.consequence: USER_EXPERIENCE remains NOT_YET_BROWSER_VERIFIED. No visual acceptance claim made. No source redesign or redeployment performed.

result: The supplied NayaNET Hub static artifact was deployed to the supplied Cloudflare Worker and independently verified live. Cloudflare deployment completed successfully as version 5e010f01-fda5-4783-b7cb-ca56691ed878, and the runtime returned the expected NayaNET Hub markers. Rendered browser acceptance remains open because the available browser retrieval surface did not return the live page.

failure.root_cause: The first deployment attempt failed because the workflow tested the Cloudflare secret at step scope before binding it to the job, and the second attempt failed because the Wrangler config was outside the repository so ./dist resolved under RUNNER_TEMP. Both failures were repaired surgically before the successful deployment.
failure.lesson: The actual Cloudflare path was available; the problem was workflow configuration, not Cloudflare access. Do not describe this state as Cloudflare blocked.

next_action.title: Browser-verify the live Cloudflare Hub
